About

Hey, I'm Louise

I'm all about helping couples plan weddings that feel relaxed, personal and genuinely enjoyable to put together.

After planning my own wedding, I realised how quickly the excitement can get buried under pressure, opinions and endless decisions. It is very easy to lose sight of what you actually want.

I created The Good Part Weddings to help couples slow things down, feel more confident in their decisions and enjoy the process a little more along the way.

How I can Help

Get in touch

Full Service

Full or Partial Planning

Support bringing every part of your wedding together, from venues and suppliers to timelines and on the day coordination.

The aim is simple. To make the process feel calmer, clearer and far less overwhelming.

Self-Led

DIY Planning Package

For couples planning their own wedding but wanting some guidance and reassurance along the way.

You will have access to tools, templates and support whenever you need a bit of direction or someone to sense check your plans.

On the Day

Coordination

Perfect for couples who want to plan their own wedding but do not want to manage it on the day.

I take care of the timelines, supplier coordination and behind the scenes logistics so everything runs smoothly and you can stay focused on what matters most.

My Philosophy

Say no to
Tradition

Some couples love tradition. Others want something smaller and more personal.

A wedding where people relax, stay longer and remember how it felt. That is the kind of wedding I love helping couples create: one that looks and feels entirely like you.

The Process

The Planning Experience

Calm, thoughtful planning for weddings that feel like you. From your first message to the moment you say I do, here is how we work together.

1

Get in Touch

Drop me a message with a little about you and your plans. No pressure, no hard sell. Just a friendly conversation to see if we are the right fit.

2

Build the Plan

We turn your ideas into a clear, structured plan. Venues, suppliers, timelines and budgets. Everything mapped out so nothing gets missed.

3

Handle the Detail

I manage the logistics behind the scenes so you stay present for the moments that matter. Supplier communication, confirmations and problem-solving: all taken care of.

4

Enjoy Your Day

On the day, everything runs as it should. You arrive, you breathe, you enjoy every moment — exactly as it was always meant to be.

Ready to enjoy the planning as much as the day itself?
